node.title: Parameterized Regex
node.author: QM
node.doctext:
I came across the term "parameterized regex" today. Apparently it's been around (and misused) since at least 2009.

Here's a "parameterized regex": m/^The quick brown (?\w+) jumps over the lazy (?\w+)\.$/

(This is called a [http://perldoc.perl.org/perlre.html#(?%27NAME%27pattern)|named capture].)

What is the prevalent name for this feature, beyond my small Perl worldview?

-QM
